system.description:
Mighty Set himself has foretold your coming, and the elders whisper that you figure prominently in one or more of the Prophecies of Set. This mark of great destiny carries weight among devout Setites, but also makes you a prize sought after by ambitious elders hoping to bask in the reflected glow of Set's favor. The prophecy in question may not come to pass for centuries, but your fate will not be denied.

This is a variable Merit; its cost represents the perceived importance of your role in the prophecy. Each Trait purchased allows you to cancel a single failed challenge once per story, but also raises the expectations your clan holds for you. The Storyteller may decide that one of your prophecies is soon to be fulfilled, making you the locus of events you may or may not control. This Merit does not by itself grant authority among other Setites — for that, you must purchase the Status Background.
system.source: Libellus Sanguinis III: Wolves at the Door, Book Three
